function.name: IS_PLAYING_WAV
function.param: Identifier of channel returned by PLAY_WAV
function.abstract: It returns 1 if an sound effect is still playing

description.p: This function checks if any sound effect reproduced before by the function is still playing. In oppositive case this function will return 0. We must know that the channel can be use after for other sound effects, so that it is not secure to use this function if it has returned 0.
